About Us

Overview:
AWKUM Business Incubation Center (BIC) has been established in November, 2015 Vide notification F.No.1(1)/AWKUM/2015/14623. Mr. Shah Hussain Awan (Faculty Member, Institute of Business Studies & Leadership), who conceived the idea to establish Business Incubation center at AWKUM, was nominated as the coordinator of BIC for promoting entrepreneurship in the University. AWKUM had already well-established society for the promotion of entrepreneurial activities among students and faculty. The society has participated in various national events. The pioneer members of the society, Mr. Amad Ali Shah, Ms Charanjeet Kaur, and Ms Mehwish Nadeem, have won the second prize in All Pakistan Business Plan Competition held at FAST University, Peshawar Campus. The members of the society have also remained runners up in many business plan competitions held in 2012 and 2013.
Mission Statement:
The BIC undertakes to furnish students, a platform, with opportunities, for developing and enhancing their basic entrepreneurial skills by realizing the potential of profitable opportunities. We aim to focus on educating the future leaders, innovators and entrepreneurs, who have the desire to be involved in ideas pertaining to business development.
Objectives:
To foster innovation in the students of AWKUM
To enable students develop their entrepreneurship skills
To build a network between students startups and business community on national and international level
To organize seminars and workshops on business plan activities
To explore the creative angles of business management
To convert new ideas into real projects
To commercialize important research projects undergoing in University

What we do

Business Incubation Center:
Establishment of BIC is a need of time. The main functional areas of the center are:
Business Incubation Services
:
AWKUM BIC provides business inclusive atmosphere to fresh graduates to become a successful entrepreneurs and help them to establish successful business. AWKUM BIC provides training and consultancy services, financial and marketing services, network and tools to new startups. The center also helps to establish industry-academia linkages to strengthen R&D activities at AWKUM.

Entrepreneurial workshops/Events:
AWKUM BIC organizes various workshops and seminars on business planning. Short training courses are organized on starting new business, mentoring, financial support, marketing services, etc. Guest speakers will be invited to share the experience of starting a new business with students and faculties.

Collaboration & partnerships:
AWKUM BIC will establish linkages between academia and industry, which will strengthen ties between education institution and business community. The center aims to sign MoUs with various government and private institutions.

Research & Development:
AWKUM has enriched research faculty and resources. The center will not restrict to the Faculty of Business & Economics rather it will expand its activities to all the faculties to facilitate the ongoing research projects.
